words.enDefinition: a card that identifies someone enrolled in a health plan

examples.en: I brought my health insurance card to the campus clinic after morning class.
examples.zh: 上午下课后，我带着「医疗保险卡」去了校医院。

examples.en: The receptionist asked to see my health insurance card when I checked in.
examples.zh: 我签到时，前台请我出示「医疗保险卡」。

words.enDefinition: the identifier a health plan assigns to an enrolled member

examples.en: The form asks for the insurance member ID printed on my digital card.
examples.zh: 表格要求填写我电子卡上印的「保险会员编号」。

examples.en: I read the insurance member ID aloud when I called the benefits office.
examples.zh: 我打电话给福利办公室时，念出了「保险会员编号」。

collocations: look up an insurance member ID

words.enDefinition: a number identifying an employer or school plan group

examples.en: My card lists a group number just below the name of the university.
examples.zh: 我的卡上在学校名称正下方印有「团体保险编号」。

examples.en: The billing office asked for my group number after I updated my plan.
examples.zh: 我更新保险方案后，账单部门问我要了「团体保险编号」。

words.enDefinition: a number that identifies a particular insurance contract

examples.en: I copied my insurance policy number into the form for overseas study.
examples.zh: 我把「保单号」填到了海外学习申请表上。

examples.en: The insurance policy number on my confirmation letter matches the number online.
examples.zh: 确认函上的「保单号」和网站上的号码相同。

words.enDefinition: a document confirming that a person has insurance

examples.en: The exchange office requested proof of coverage before approving my semester abroad.
examples.zh: 交换项目办公室要求先提供「投保证明」，再批准我出国一学期。

examples.en: I downloaded proof of coverage from the insurer's website for my student records.
examples.zh: 我从保险公司网站下载了「投保证明」，放进自己的学生档案。

words.enDefinition: the day an insurance plan begins covering a person

examples.en: I checked the coverage start date because I arrived three days before orientation.
examples.zh: 我比迎新早到了三天，所以查了「保障生效日」。

examples.en: The email confirms a coverage start date in August for the new policy.
examples.zh: 邮件确认了新保单的「保障生效日」在八月。

words.enDefinition: a student-focused plan that helps pay for healthcare

examples.en: I read about the student health insurance plan before choosing my classes online.
examples.zh: 在网上选课前，我先了解了「学生医疗保险方案」。

examples.en: Our international office explained how the student health insurance plan works during summer break.
examples.zh: 国际学生办公室说明了暑假期间「学生医疗保险方案」如何提供保障。

collocations: enrol in a student health insurance plan

words.enDefinition: a request to opt out of a school's insurance plan

examples.en: My student health insurance waiver was still pending when tuition charges appeared online.
examples.zh: 学费出现在网上时，我的「学生医保豁免申请」还在审核。

examples.en: The university asked me to attach my policy details to the student health insurance waiver.
examples.zh: 学校要求我在「学生医保豁免申请」里附上现有保单资料。

collocations: submit a student health insurance waiver
approve a student health insurance waiver
check a student health insurance waiver

words.enDefinition: evidence that another policy provides a similar level of protection

examples.en: The waiver form requests proof of comparable coverage from my current insurance company.
examples.zh: 豁免表要求提交现有保险公司出具的「同等保障证明」。

examples.en: She asked which documents counted as proof of comparable coverage at this university.
examples.zh: 她问这所学校认可哪些文件作为「同等保障证明」。

words.enDefinition: an eligible family member insured under another person's plan

examples.en: The policy lists my spouse as a covered dependent during my exchange semester.
examples.zh: 保单把我配偶列为交换学期内的「受保家属」。

examples.en: I checked whether my child appeared as a covered dependent on the new card.
examples.zh: 我查了一下新卡上是否把我的孩子列为「受保家属」。

words.enDefinition: health insurance that extends to eligible family members

examples.en: The enrolment form asks whether I want dependent coverage for my family.
examples.zh: 投保表问我是否要给家人加上「家属保险保障」。

examples.en: I asked our student benefits office how dependent coverage works during school breaks.
examples.zh: 我向学生福利办公室询问假期里「家属保险保障」如何运作。

words.enDefinition: the insurance plan that considers a claim before another plan

examples.en: The clinic asked me to identify my primary insurance before sending the claim.
examples.zh: 诊所提交理赔前，请我说明哪份是我的「第一顺位保险」。

examples.en: My benefits adviser helped me check which policy counted as my primary insurance.
examples.zh: 福利顾问帮我查清哪份保单算我的「第一顺位保险」。

words.enDefinition: the insurance plan that may contribute after the first plan responds

examples.en: The billing team needed my secondary insurance details to review the remaining balance.
examples.zh: 账单部门需要我的「第二顺位保险」资料，才能核对剩下的余额。

examples.en: I asked whether my secondary insurance had received the paperwork from the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问了自己的「第二顺位保险」有没有收到诊所发来的材料。

words.enDefinition: rules that determine how multiple health plans share claim payment

examples.en: I had to complete a coordination of benefits form after adding a second plan.
examples.zh: 加保第二份保险后，我得填一份「多份保险给付协调」表。

examples.en: The insurer explained how coordination of benefits affected the payment for that appointment.
examples.zh: 保险公司说明了「多份保险给付协调」如何影响那次就诊的赔付。

words.enDefinition: a short description of what a health plan covers

examples.en: The summary of benefits helped me find the section about campus clinic visits.
examples.zh: 我在「保障摘要」里找到了关于校医院就诊的部分。

examples.en: I compared the summary of benefits with the full policy to clarify a charge.
examples.zh: 我对照「保障摘要」和完整保单，想弄清一笔费用。

words.enDefinition: a booklet describing the details of an insurance plan

examples.en: I marked the page about dependents in the benefits booklet from the university.
examples.zh: 我在学校发的「保险保障手册」里标了讲家属的那页。

examples.en: The benefits booklet lists separate support numbers for policy questions and claims.
examples.zh: 「保险保障手册」分别列出了保单咨询和理赔咨询的电话。

words.enDefinition: a recurring amount paid to maintain insurance coverage

examples.en: My tuition statement shows the insurance premium on a separate line this term.
examples.zh: 这学期的学费账单把「保险费」单列了一行。

examples.en: We compared the total insurance premium before choosing plans for our exchange year.
examples.zh: 为交换学年选保险方案之前，我们对比了全部「保险费」。

words.enDefinition: a period when a person has no active insurance coverage

examples.en: I asked the office whether changing plans midterm would create a coverage gap.
examples.zh: 我问办公室，中途换方案会不会出现「保障空档」。

examples.en: The confirmation letter showed a coverage gap between July and September that I hadn't noticed.
examples.zh: 确认函显示七月到九月有一段我之前没注意到的「保障空档」。

words.enDefinition: the day when protection under an insurance plan ends

examples.en: I asked the adviser to confirm the coverage termination date after my graduation.
examples.zh: 我请顾问确认我毕业后的「保障终止日」。

examples.en: The coverage termination date appears on the notice beside my current address.
examples.zh: 通知上的现住址旁边印着「保障终止日」。

words.enDefinition: the scheduled time each year for joining or changing a plan

examples.en: The annual enrollment period began while I was deciding whether to study overseas.
examples.zh: 我还在考虑是否出国学习时，「年度投保期」就开始了。

examples.en: I saved the annual enrollment period in my calendar to review the new options.
examples.zh: 我把「年度投保期」记进日历，好在那时看看新选项。

words.enDefinition: a window for enrolling outside the regular enrollment period

examples.en: I asked whether graduating early could qualify me for a special enrollment period.
examples.zh: 我问提前毕业是否符合「特殊投保期」的申请条件。

examples.en: The adviser explained which documents I needed for the special enrollment period.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了「特殊投保期」内我需要哪些材料。

collocations: qualify for a special enrollment period
apply during a special enrollment period

words.enDefinition: the twelve-month period used to administer a health plan

examples.en: Our plan year starts before classes and ends during the following summer break.
examples.zh: 我们的「保险计划年度」在开学前开始，到次年暑假结束。

examples.en: I checked the new plan year before booking a follow-up at the campus clinic.
examples.zh: 在校医院预约复诊前，我查了新的「保险计划年度」。

words.enDefinition: a healthcare service eligible for payment under a plan

examples.en: The adviser helped me check whether the blood test was a covered service.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我查了这项验血是不是「承保服务」。

examples.en: The statement lists each covered service separately from the items I paid for myself.
examples.zh: 清单把每项「承保服务」和我全额自费的项目分开列了。

words.enDefinition: a service or situation specifically left outside an insurance policy

examples.en: I noticed a coverage exclusion in the plan and asked the insurer to explain it.
examples.zh: 我发现保险方案中有一条「除外责任」，就请保险公司解释。

examples.en: The office explained why a coverage exclusion showed up in my plan summary.
examples.zh: 办公室说明了为什么我的保障摘要里会出现一条「除外责任」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount or extent of protection provided by a policy

examples.en: The insurer told me where to find the coverage limit for that service.
examples.zh: 保险公司告诉我到哪儿查该服务的「保障上限」。

examples.en: I noted the coverage limit beside each option while comparing the university plans.
examples.zh: 比较学校的几个保险方案时，我在每个选项旁标了「保障上限」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum number of visits a plan covers for a benefit

examples.en: The plan summary shows a visit limit for appointments with that kind of provider.
examples.zh: 保障摘要里写着，这类提供者的预约有「就诊次数上限」。

examples.en: I asked whether the visit limit would reset at the beginning of the next term.
examples.zh: 我问「就诊次数上限」到下学期开始时会不会重置。

words.enDefinition: whether care is considered clinically appropriate for a condition

examples.en: The insurer sent a form asking the provider to explain the medical necessity of the test.
examples.zh: 保险公司发了一张表，请提供者解释这项检查的「医疗必要性」。

examples.en: I asked what medical necessity meant in the letter about the coverage decision.
examples.zh: 我问了关于保障决定的信里「医疗必要性」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: approval a plan requires before certain services or medicines are supplied

examples.en: The billing office was waiting for prior authorization when I called on Monday.
examples.zh: 我周一打电话时，账单部门还在等「事前授权」。

examples.en: I asked the insurer whether prior authorization was needed for the proposed visit.
examples.zh: 我问保险公司，安排的那次就诊是否需要「事前授权」。

words.enDefinition: a reference identifying an insurance approval for a service

examples.en: The clinic asked me to keep the authorization number until the claim was settled.
examples.zh: 诊所让我保留「审批编号」，等理赔处理完再说。

examples.en: I copied the authorization number from the letter into the online form.
examples.zh: 我把信里的「审批编号」填进了网上表格。

words.enDefinition: a rule that makes a referral necessary for some visits

examples.en: I asked the plan about its referral requirement before booking the specialist visit.
examples.zh: 约专科前，我先向保险计划方询问了「转诊要求」。

examples.en: The clinic explained which type of referral requirement applied to my particular plan.
examples.zh: 诊所解释了我的这份保险方案适用哪种「转诊要求」。

words.enDefinition: a group of providers with contracts under a health plan

examples.en: My student plan added a nearby clinic to its provider network last year.
examples.zh: 去年，我的学生医保把附近一家诊所加入了「医疗服务网络」。

examples.en: The campus clinic showed me how to search the provider network by location.
examples.zh: 校医院教我怎么按地点搜索「医疗服务网络」里的机构。

words.zhGloss: 保险网络内医疗服务方
words.enDefinition: a healthcare provider contracted with a particular insurance plan
acceptedZhAnswers: 保险网络内医疗服务方

examples.en: I picked an in-network provider near campus so the appointment wouldn't involve a long commute.
examples.zh: 我选了学校附近的「保险网络内医疗服务方」，去看诊不用跑太远。

examples.en: The number on my card can help me find an in-network provider.
examples.zh: 打我卡上的电话，可以帮我找到「保险网络内医疗服务方」。

words.zhGloss: 保险网络外医疗服务方
words.enDefinition: a healthcare provider without a contract with a particular health plan
acceptedZhAnswers: 保险网络外医疗服务方

examples.en: The clinic told me it was an out-of-network provider under my current policy.
examples.zh: 诊所告诉我，按我现在的保单，它属于「保险网络外医疗服务方」。

examples.en: I asked my plan how it handles visits to an out-of-network provider.
examples.zh: 我问保险计划方，如果去「保险网络外医疗服务方」那里就诊，怎么算费用。

words.enDefinition: a searchable list of providers linked to an insurance plan

examples.en: I used the provider directory to find an office near the campus shuttle stop.
examples.zh: 我用「医疗服务者名录」找到了校园班车站附近的一家诊所。

examples.en: The provider directory showed an old address, so I rang the clinic first.
examples.zh: 「医疗服务者名录」显示的是旧地址，所以我先给诊所打了电话。

words.enDefinition: whether a provider belongs to a particular insurer's network

examples.en: Please check the clinic's network status under the plan listed on my card.
examples.zh: 请查一下这家诊所在我卡上所列保险方案下的「入网状态」。

examples.en: The plan confirmed the specialist's network status after I gave them the address.
examples.zh: 我报了地址后，保险计划方确认了这位专科医生的「入网状态」。

words.enDefinition: plan coverage for care received from providers outside its network

examples.en: I checked the out-of-network benefits after learning that the nearby clinic wasn't contracted.
examples.zh: 得知附近诊所没有签约后，我查了「网络外保障」。

examples.en: Our benefit guide explains which out-of-network benefits apply away from campus during breaks.
examples.zh: 保障指南说明了放假离开学校时，可以用哪些「网络外保障」。

words.enDefinition: prices contracted between a health plan and its network providers

examples.en: The insurance office explained how the in-network rates affected what the clinic could charge.
examples.zh: 保险办公室解释了「网络内费率」会怎样影响诊所的收费。

examples.en: I asked whether the new plan had different in-network rates for campus visits.
examples.zh: 我问新的保险方案对校内就诊是否有不同的「网络内费率」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount a plan recognizes for a covered service

examples.en: The allowed amount on my statement was lower than the clinic's original charge.
examples.zh: 账单上的「核准计费金额」低于诊所原先收取的金额。

examples.en: I asked why the allowed amount had changed since my first visit.
examples.zh: 我问了为什么第一次看诊以来，「核准计费金额」变了。

words.enDefinition: the amount a provider initially charges for a service

examples.en: The billed amount appears on the left side of my benefits statement.
examples.zh: 我的理赔说明单左侧列着「账单原始金额」。

examples.en: I compared the billed amount with the price listed on the clinic's receipt.
examples.zh: 我把「账单原始金额」和诊所收据上列的价格作了对比。

words.enDefinition: an amount removed from a charge under an insurance agreement

examples.en: The contractual adjustment explains part of the difference between the two figures on my bill.
examples.zh: 这笔「合同减记额」解释了账单上两个数字的一部分差额。

examples.en: I asked the billing office where the contractual adjustment appeared on the revised statement.
examples.zh: 我问账单部门，修正后的账单上哪里显示「合同减记额」。

words.enDefinition: billing a patient for the gap between charges and the allowed amount

examples.en: The benefits office explained balance billing when I asked about the extra amount.
examples.zh: 我问起多出的那笔金额时，福利办公室给我解释了「差额收费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the unexpected charge was an example of balance billing.
examples.zh: 我问那笔意料外的费用是不是「差额收费」的一种。

words.enDefinition: an unexpected charge for healthcare that a patient thought was covered

examples.en: I brought the surprise medical bill to the student support office for help reading it.
examples.zh: 我把「意外医疗账单」带到学生服务办公室，请他们帮我看。

examples.en: My roommate found a surprise medical bill in the mail after returning from break.
examples.zh: 室友放假回来后，在邮件里发现一张「意外医疗账单」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged to patients who pay without using insurance

examples.en: The campus clinic quoted a self-pay rate when I asked about the visit.
examples.zh: 我问校医院那次就诊要多少钱，他们报了一个「自费价格」。

examples.en: I asked for the self-pay rate in writing so I could compare both figures.
examples.zh: 我请对方把「自费价格」写下来，好对比两个数字。

words.enDefinition: a patient who pays the provider without billing insurance

examples.en: The receptionist checked whether I was listed as a self-pay patient for that visit.
examples.zh: 前台核对那次就诊是否把我登记成了「自费患者」。

examples.en: A self-pay patient can ask the office to explain the total on the estimate.
examples.zh: 「自费患者」可以请办公室解释估价单上的总额。

words.enDefinition: to cover a charge yourself using your own money

examples.en: I wanted to know how much I would pay out of pocket for the visit.
examples.zh: 我想知道那次就诊自己得「掏多少费用」。

examples.en: We asked whether we'd need to pay out of pocket before getting reimbursed.
examples.zh: 我们问，在拿到报销前是否需要「自掏费用」。

collocations: have to pay out of pocket
choose to pay out of pocket

words.enDefinition: a cap on what you pay for qualifying care during a plan year

examples.en: The summary lists an out-of-pocket maximum next to the annual deductible for my plan.
examples.zh: 保障摘要把我的「年度自付上限」列在年度免赔额旁边。

examples.en: I asked which charges would count toward the out-of-pocket maximum on my student plan.
examples.zh: 我问了学生保险中有哪些费用会计入「年度自付上限」。

words.enDefinition: an amount you pay before a plan starts sharing certain costs

examples.en: I checked the deductible before comparing the two student health plans online.
examples.zh: 我先看了「免赔额」，才在网上比较两种学生医疗保险。

examples.en: My statement showed what remained on the deductible after the clinic visit.
examples.zh: 账单显示了在诊所看诊后还剩多少「免赔额」未达到。

words.enDefinition: used when a service is subject to the plan's deductible

examples.en: The table says deductible applies beside the entry for my particular lab test.
examples.zh: 表格在我的那项化验旁标了「适用免赔额」。

examples.en: Ask what deductible applies means on this line if the statement is unclear.
examples.zh: 如果账单说得不清楚，可以问这一行「适用免赔额」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: to pay enough qualifying costs to reach the plan's deductible

examples.en: The chart shows how much I still need to spend to meet the deductible.
examples.zh: 图表显示，我还需付多少费用才能「达到免赔额」。

examples.en: My adviser explained what happens after I meet the deductible on this particular plan.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了在这份方案中「达到免赔额」之后会怎样计算费用。

words.enDefinition: a deductible amount that applies across people on a family plan

examples.en: The policy lists a family deductible as well as a separate amount for each member.
examples.zh: 保单列有一项「家庭免赔额」，同时也列出了每位成员各自的金额。

examples.en: I asked which charges counted toward the family deductible after my spouse's visit.
examples.zh: 配偶看诊后，我问了哪些费用计入「家庭免赔额」。

words.enDefinition: a fixed amount a patient pays for a covered service

examples.en: The receptionist told me the copay amount before I checked out that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午我离开前，前台告诉了我「定额自付费用」的金额。

examples.en: I noticed that the campus clinic copay was listed separately on the plan summary.
examples.zh: 我留意到保障摘要把校医院的「定额自付费用」单独列了出来。

words.enDefinition: the patient's percentage of the allowed amount for a covered service

examples.en: The benefits adviser explained coinsurance when I asked why the charge wasn't fixed.
examples.zh: 我问金额为什么不是固定的，福利顾问给我解释了「按比例自付」。

examples.en: The plan summary lists coinsurance for some visits and a fixed charge for others.
examples.zh: 保障摘要写着，有的就诊「按比例自付」，另一些按固定金额收费。

words.enDefinition: the portion of covered costs that a patient must pay

examples.en: I read the cost sharing section to understand what my own share might be.
examples.zh: 我读了「医疗费用分担」那一节，想了解自己可能承担多少。

examples.en: The comparison sheet shows cost sharing separately from the monthly insurance payment.
examples.zh: 对比表将「医疗费用分担」与每月交的保险费分开呈现。

words.enDefinition: a projected price given before healthcare is delivered

examples.en: The clinic sent me a pre-service estimate before my scheduled appointment next month.
examples.zh: 诊所在我下个月预约就诊前，发来了一份「诊疗前费用估算」。

examples.en: I saved the pre-service estimate to compare it with the statement after my visit.
examples.zh: 我保留了「诊疗前费用估算」，方便就诊后跟账单核对。

words.enDefinition: a prediction of the amount a patient will owe after coverage

examples.en: My form shows estimated patient responsibility in bold beneath the total charge.
examples.zh: 表格在总费用下方用粗体标了「预计患者自付金额」。

examples.en: I asked which items were included in the estimated patient responsibility on the quote.
examples.zh: 我问报价中「预计患者自付金额」包括哪些项目。

words.enDefinition: the amount still owed by a patient on an account

examples.en: I called the clinic after a patient balance appeared in the portal.
examples.zh: 系统里出现一笔「患者待付金额」后，我给诊所打了电话。

examples.en: The billing office updated the patient balance after it processed my last payment.
examples.zh: 账单部门处理完我的上一笔付款后，更新了「患者待付金额」。

words.enDefinition: a healthcare bill that has not yet been paid

examples.en: I spotted an unpaid medical bill while sorting through mail after the break.
examples.zh: 假期回来整理邮件时，我发现了一张「未付医疗账单」。

examples.en: The billing team found an unpaid medical bill from my visit two months ago.
examples.zh: 账单部门找到了我两个月前看诊产生的一张「未付医疗账单」。

collocations: ask about an unpaid medical bill

words.enDefinition: the office responsible for charges and payments at an organisation

examples.en: I called the billing department to ask why the statement showed my old address.
examples.zh: 我给「账单部门」打电话，问为什么账单显示的是旧地址。

examples.en: The receptionist transferred me to the billing department after I mentioned the charge.
examples.zh: 我提到那笔费用后，前台把我转接到了「账单部门」。

words.enDefinition: a statement showing charges, payments and the amount remaining

examples.en: The billing statement shows both the visit charge and what I paid that day.
examples.zh: 「费用对账单」既列了看诊费用，也列了我当天付的钱。

examples.en: I downloaded the billing statement before calling the university benefits adviser for help.
examples.zh: 给学校福利顾问打电话求助前，我下载了「费用对账单」。

words.enDefinition: a payment document listing healthcare services and their charges

examples.en: I attached the medical invoice to the claim after my appointment at the clinic.
examples.zh: 在诊所看完病后，我把「医疗账单」附到了理赔申请上。

examples.en: The medical invoice lists the clinic's address and the date of my visit.
examples.zh: 「医疗账单」列有诊所地址和我的看诊日期。

words.enDefinition: a bill with each service and charge shown separately

examples.en: I asked the hospital for an itemized bill so I could see each charge.
examples.zh: 我向医院要了「明细账单」，这样能看清每项收费。

examples.en: The itemized bill helped me match a lab fee to the correct appointment.
examples.zh: 这份「明细账单」让我把一笔化验费和对应的就诊对上了。

words.enDefinition: a code used to identify a charge in a billing system

examples.en: The clinic explained which billing code appeared next to the charge I had questioned.
examples.zh: 诊所解释了我提出疑问的那笔费用旁是什么「计费代码」。

examples.en: I read the billing code aloud while the adviser looked up the claim.
examples.zh: 顾问查理赔时，我把「计费代码」念给了对方。

words.enDefinition: a standard code identifying a medical procedure or service

examples.en: The claim shows a procedure code beside the name of the lab test.
examples.zh: 理赔记录在化验名称旁列有「医疗操作代码」。

examples.en: I asked the clinic to confirm the procedure code printed on my statement.
examples.zh: 我请诊所确认账单上印的「医疗操作代码」。

words.enDefinition: a standard code used to represent a medical diagnosis

examples.en: The referral form included a diagnosis code that the specialist's office asked me to confirm.
examples.zh: 转诊表里有个「诊断代码」，专科医生的办公室请我核对一下。

examples.en: I asked which diagnosis code was listed on the copy of my claim.
examples.zh: 我问了理赔单副本上列的是哪个「诊断代码」。

words.enDefinition: the date when healthcare was provided or a service occurred

examples.en: The date of service isn't the same as the date my statement arrived.
examples.zh: 「就诊服务日期」和我收到这份账单的日期不一样。

examples.en: I checked the date of service to see which appointment the claim referred to.
examples.zh: 我核对了「就诊服务日期」，确定这笔理赔对应哪次预约。

words.enDefinition: a charge for using a healthcare facility and its resources

examples.en: The hospital statement shows a facility fee in addition to the clinician's charge.
examples.zh: 医院账单除了医生的收费，还列了一笔「医疗机构场地费」。

examples.en: I called the clinic to ask whether the estimate included a facility fee.
examples.zh: 我打电话给诊所，问估价中是否含有「医疗机构场地费」。

words.enDefinition: a charge for the work of a clinician or other professional

examples.en: I received a separate statement for the professional fee after my campus referral.
examples.zh: 学校转诊后，我收到一份单列「医务人员服务费」的账单。

examples.en: The billing clerk told me which part of the total was the professional fee.
examples.zh: 账单员告诉我总费用里的哪一部分是「医务人员服务费」。

words.enDefinition: the practice of issuing different bills for related services

examples.en: The receptionist mentioned separate billing for the lab work and the clinic appointment.
examples.zh: 前台提到，化验和诊所看诊会「分开计费」。

examples.en: I didn't expect separate billing, so I called when the second statement arrived.
examples.zh: 我没想到会「分开计费」，所以收到第二份账单时打了电话。

words.enDefinition: a request for an insurer to pay for a covered expense

examples.en: My insurance claim showed up in the portal a week after the visit.
examples.zh: 看诊一周后，我的「保险理赔申请」出现在了在线系统。

examples.en: I asked the office who was responsible for filing the insurance claim.
examples.zh: 我问办公室，应该由谁提交这笔「保险理赔申请」。

words.enDefinition: to send an insurer a request for payment under a policy

examples.en: The clinic told me how to submit a claim after my appointment.
examples.zh: 看诊后，诊所告诉我怎么「提交理赔申请」。

examples.en: Can I submit a claim online if I paid the provider at reception?
examples.zh: 如果我在前台就付了钱，能在网上「提交理赔申请」吗？

words.enDefinition: a form used to request an insurance payment

examples.en: I entered the appointment date on the claim form before attaching the receipt.
examples.zh: 我先把就诊日期填进「理赔申请表」，再附上收据。

examples.en: The insurance office sent a new claim form after I selected the wrong policy.
examples.zh: 我选错保单后，保险办公室发来一张新的「理赔申请表」。

words.enDefinition: a reference number for a particular insurance claim

examples.en: I wrote down the claim number so I could refer to it later.
examples.zh: 我记下了「理赔编号」，以后就能用它查询。

examples.en: The adviser used my claim number to find the correct record online.
examples.zh: 顾问用我的「理赔编号」，在网上找到了相应记录。

words.enDefinition: the last date a plan accepts a claim submission

examples.en: I found the claim filing deadline in the guide sent by the insurer.
examples.zh: 我在保险公司发的指南里找到了「理赔申报截止日」。

examples.en: The adviser wrote down the claim filing deadline for the receipt I brought.
examples.zh: 顾问记下了我带来的那张收据所对应的「理赔申报截止日」。

words.enDefinition: a claim that has not yet received a final decision

examples.en: I called to ask what information was missing from my pending claim.
examples.zh: 我打电话问这笔「待处理理赔」还缺什么信息。

examples.en: The pending claim remained in the portal while the clinic checked its records.
examples.zh: 诊所核对记录期间，系统里仍显示这笔「待处理理赔」。

words.enDefinition: the current stage or result of an insurance claim

examples.en: I signed into the portal to check my claim status during lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭时我登录在线系统，查了一下「理赔进度」。

examples.en: The adviser said my claim status would change once the corrected bill arrived.
examples.zh: 顾问说，修正的账单一到，我的「理赔进度」就会更新。

words.enDefinition: a plan's agreement to pay all or part of a submitted claim

examples.en: I received an email about claim approval while waiting for the campus shuttle.
examples.zh: 等校车时，我收到了一封「理赔获批」的邮件。

examples.en: The claim approval notice lists the amount the plan intends to pay toward the bill.
examples.zh: 「理赔获批」通知列有保险计划方打算承担的账单金额。

words.enDefinition: a decision to refuse payment of a claim or part of it

examples.en: I asked the benefits office to explain the claim denial in simple language.
examples.zh: 我请福利办公室用简单的话解释这笔「理赔拒付」。

examples.en: The claim denial described which documents the insurer had used in its review.
examples.zh: 「理赔拒付」通知写明了保险公司审核时用了哪些材料。

words.enDefinition: the explanation a plan gives for declining a claim

examples.en: I checked the denial reason listed beneath the appointment date on the letter.
examples.zh: 我查了信里看诊日期下面列出的「拒付原因」。

examples.en: The insurer gave a different denial reason after receiving the updated record.
examples.zh: 收到更新后的记录，保险公司给了不同的「拒付原因」。

words.enDefinition: a letter explaining why an insurer rejected a claim

examples.en: The denial letter came after I had already sent the clinic receipt twice.
examples.zh: 我已经发了两遍诊所收据，之后才收到「拒付通知函」。

examples.en: I asked the student adviser to read the denial letter with me.
examples.zh: 我请学生顾问陪我一起看那封「拒付通知函」。

words.enDefinition: a request for an insurer to review its claim decision

examples.en: I gathered my documents before filing a claim appeal through the insurer's portal.
examples.zh: 我先整理了材料，再通过保险公司系统提起「理赔申诉」。

examples.en: The benefits adviser asked what decision I wanted reviewed in my claim appeal.
examples.zh: 福利顾问问，我希望在这次「理赔申诉」中复核哪项决定。

words.enDefinition: a review of a decision by a body outside the insurer

examples.en: The notice explains what external review means for my particular type of decision.
examples.zh: 通知解释了对我这类决定做「外部复核」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked whether external review was available after the plan completed its appeal process.
examples.zh: 保险计划方完成申诉处理后，我问还能不能申请「外部复核」。

words.enDefinition: a claim revised after an error in its filing or processing

examples.en: The clinic sent an adjusted claim after fixing the date on my bill.
examples.zh: 诊所更正了账单上的日期后，提交了「调整后的理赔申请」。

examples.en: I compared the adjusted claim with the original one before calling the adviser.
examples.zh: 给顾问打电话前，我先对照了「调整后的理赔申请」和原记录。

words.enDefinition: to send an insurance claim again after fixing or adding information

examples.en: I needed to resubmit a claim with the itemized receipt attached this time.
examples.zh: 我需要「重新提交理赔」，这次要附上明细收据。

examples.en: The office said it could resubmit a claim after correcting the service code.
examples.zh: 办公室说改正服务代码后，可以「重新提交理赔」。

collocations: ask the clinic to resubmit a claim

words.enDefinition: an insurer statement summarizing charges and coverage for a claim

examples.en: The explanation of benefits showed a patient share that differed from the clinic bill.
examples.zh: 「理赔结算说明」显示的患者自付额与诊所账单不同。

examples.en: I kept the explanation of benefits because it was separate from the clinic's bill.
examples.zh: 我留存了「理赔结算说明」，因为它和诊所的账单是分开的。

words.enDefinition: a request to be paid back for an expense already paid

examples.en: I sent a reimbursement claim after paying for the visit during my exchange.
examples.zh: 交换期间看诊付完费后，我提交了「报销申请」。

examples.en: The reimbursement claim asked how much I had paid at the clinic that day.
examples.zh: 「报销申请」问我那天在诊所付了多少费用。

words.enDefinition: the share of a qualifying expense paid back by a plan

examples.en: The reimbursement rate differed between the two plans in the comparison sheet.
examples.zh: 对比表里的两个保险方案，「报销比例」不同。

examples.en: I asked the adviser how to find the reimbursement rate for that type of visit.
examples.zh: 我问顾问去哪里查那类就诊的「报销比例」。

words.enDefinition: repayment of only part of an expense

examples.en: I received partial reimbursement and asked which items the insurer had excluded.
examples.zh: 我拿到了「部分报销」，就问保险公司哪些项目没有报。

examples.en: The notice shows partial reimbursement for the appointment and no payment for the extra service.
examples.zh: 通知显示这次看诊得到「部分报销」，额外服务没有赔付。

words.enDefinition: a check of whether an insurance plan is active or applies

examples.en: The campus clinic began coverage verification when I provided my new insurance details.
examples.zh: 我提供新的保险资料后，校医院开始了「保险保障核验」。

examples.en: The receptionist said coverage verification was still in progress for the new policy.
examples.zh: 前台说这份新保单的「保险保障核验」还没完成。

words.enDefinition: to replace the insurance details kept on file for someone

examples.en: I need to update insurance information in the portal before my next appointment.
examples.zh: 下次看诊前，我要在在线系统里「更新保险资料」。

examples.en: The form allows students to update insurance information at the start of term.
examples.zh: 这份表允许学生在学期开始时「更新保险资料」。

collocations: update insurance information before a visit

words.enDefinition: the insurance details a provider already has in its records

examples.en: The office asked me to confirm the insurance information on file before billing.
examples.zh: 开账之前，办公室请我核对「已存档的保险资料」。

examples.en: My insurance information on file still pointed to the plan I had last year.
examples.zh: 「已存档的保险资料」还是我去年的保险方案。

collocations: confirm the insurance information on file

words.enDefinition: pay the clinic before or at the visit without waiting for insurance

examples.en: I had to pay the clinic upfront and keep the itemized receipt afterward.
examples.zh: 我得「先向诊所付款」，然后留好明细收据。

examples.en: We asked if students must pay the clinic upfront for visits during the exchange.
examples.zh: 我们问了交换期间看诊，学生是否必须「先向诊所付款」。

collocations: need to pay the clinic upfront
agree to pay the clinic upfront
ask whether to pay the clinic upfront

words.enDefinition: a request for help covering a bill or charges

examples.en: The hospital sent me a financial assistance application along with the billing statement.
examples.zh: 医院把「费用援助申请」和费用对账单一起发给了我。

examples.en: I asked which documents to attach to the financial assistance application for my visit.
examples.zh: 我问这次看诊的「费用援助申请」要附哪些材料。

words.enDefinition: help a hospital offers to reduce eligible patients' costs

examples.en: The student adviser showed me who to contact about hospital financial assistance.
examples.zh: 学生顾问告诉我，要咨询「医院费用援助」可以联系谁。

examples.en: I asked what hospital financial assistance was available before sending my supporting papers.
examples.zh: 发证明材料前，我问了有哪些「医院费用援助」可以申请。

words.enDefinition: free or reduced-cost healthcare for patients who meet financial criteria

examples.en: A billing adviser explained how the hospital's charity care program reviews applications.
examples.zh: 账单顾问解释了医院的「减免式医疗援助」项目怎样审核申请。

examples.en: The form shows what information is needed to be considered for charity care.
examples.zh: 表上写明了申请「减免式医疗援助」需要提供哪些资料。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement to pay a medical bill in installments

examples.en: I asked about a medical bill payment plan after opening my statement.
examples.zh: 打开账单后，我问了「医疗账单分期方案」的事。

examples.en: The clinic gave me a written medical bill payment plan with the agreed dates.
examples.zh: 诊所给了我一份书面的「医疗账单分期方案」，上面列着约定日期。

collocations: request a medical bill payment plan
agree to a medical bill payment plan
set up a medical bill payment plan

words.enDefinition: a disagreement about whether a charge is correct

examples.en: Our student advocate helped me identify who could handle a billing dispute.
examples.zh: 学生权益顾问帮我弄清了谁能处理「账单争议」。

examples.en: I kept the two statements together while the clinic looked into my billing dispute.
examples.zh: 诊所调查这起「账单争议」时，我把两份账单放在了一起。

words.enDefinition: money returned after a person has paid too much

examples.en: The clinic offered a refund of overpayment after checking both of my receipts.
examples.zh: 核对我的两张收据后，诊所提出办理「多付款退款」。

examples.en: I asked how the refund of overpayment would appear on my card statement.
examples.zh: 我问「多付款退款」会怎样显示在银行卡账单上。

words.enDefinition: a question or request about a charge on an account

examples.en: I sent a billing inquiry because the date on the statement looked wrong.
examples.zh: 账单上的日期似乎有误，所以我提交了「账单查询」。

examples.en: The email says my billing inquiry was forwarded to the clinic's accounts team.
examples.zh: 邮件说，我的「账单查询」已经转给了诊所财务组。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement where a provider sends charges straight to an insurer

examples.en: The clinic confirmed it offered direct billing for my particular student insurance plan.
examples.zh: 诊所确认我的这份学生保险可用「直接向保险方结算」。

examples.en: I asked whether direct billing was available at the clinic across from campus.
examples.zh: 我问了学校对面的诊所能不能「直接向保险方结算」。

words.enDefinition: Australian health insurance for international students studying in the country

examples.en: The university sent me information about overseas student health cover before my exchange semester.
examples.zh: 交换学期开始前，学校给我发了「赴澳留学生医疗保险」资料。

examples.en: I checked whether my overseas student health cover was listed in the student portal.
examples.zh: 我查了学生系统里有没有登记我的「赴澳留学生医疗保险」。

words.enDefinition: Australian health insurance designed for people visiting from overseas

examples.en: My parents asked about overseas visitor health cover when planning their graduation trip.
examples.zh: 爸妈规划参加毕业典礼的行程时，问起了「访澳人士医疗保险」。

examples.en: The adviser explained how overseas visitor health cover differed from my university student plan.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「访澳人士医疗保险」与我的大学生保险有何不同。

words.enDefinition: a fee adjusted according to a person's ability to pay

examples.en: The community clinic told me how it calculated a sliding-scale fee for eligible patients.
examples.zh: 社区诊所告诉我，他们怎样给符合条件的患者计算「按收入浮动的收费」。

examples.en: I asked which documents the clinic needed to assess my sliding-scale fee.
examples.zh: 我问诊所需要哪些文件来核定我的「按收入浮动的收费」。

words.enDefinition: a university charge supporting health services for students

examples.en: My tuition statement lists a student health fee and a separate insurance premium.
examples.zh: 我的学费账单列了「学生健康服务费」，保险费则在另一行。

examples.en: The student health fee was explained at orientation before we visited the campus clinic.
examples.zh: 我们参观校医院之前，迎新会上介绍了什么是「学生健康服务费」。

collocations: included in the student health fee

words.enDefinition: insurance benefits that help pay for prescription medications

examples.en: The adviser showed me where to read about prescription coverage in the plan.
examples.zh: 顾问给我指了在哪儿看保险方案的「处方药保障」。

examples.en: I compared prescription coverage as well as clinic charges when choosing my student plan.
examples.zh: 我选学生保险时既比较了门诊费用，也比较了「处方药保障」。

words.enDefinition: a list of medicines covered or preferred by a health plan

examples.en: The pharmacist checked the drug formulary after confirming which insurance plan I was on.
examples.zh: 药师确认我的保险方案后，查了「保险药品目录」。

examples.en: I found the drug formulary under the prescriptions tab in my insurer's portal.
examples.zh: 我在保险公司系统的处方页面找到了「保险药品目录」。

collocations: look up a drug in the drug formulary

words.enDefinition: insurance protection for services intended to prevent or detect health problems early

examples.en: I asked how preventive care coverage was described in the summary for international students.
examples.zh: 我问面向国际学生的摘要里怎样介绍「预防性保健保障」。

examples.en: The university adviser showed me the preventive care coverage section in the plan.
examples.zh: 学校顾问给我看了保险方案里「预防性保健保障」那一节。

words.enDefinition: the process of deciding whether and how much to pay on a claim

examples.en: The adviser explained claim adjudication when I asked why my request was taking time.
examples.zh: 我问申请为什么还没结果时，顾问给我解释了「理赔审核裁定」。

examples.en: The portal refers to claim adjudication in the page about reviewing the submitted bill.
examples.zh: 在线系统在介绍如何审核已提交账单的页面提到了「理赔审核裁定」。

words.enDefinition: used when a claim is refused because the plan excludes the service

examples.en: My claim was denied as not covered, so I asked which exclusion the insurer applied.
examples.zh: 我的理赔「因不承保而被拒付」，于是我问保险公司适用的是哪条除外条款。

examples.en: The notice says denied as not covered beside the appointment I had asked about.
examples.zh: 通知在我询问的那次看诊旁标了「因不承保而拒付」。

words.enDefinition: a provision excluding some conditions that existed before a policy began

examples.en: I asked the adviser what the pre-existing condition exclusion meant in that policy.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，这份保单中的「既往病症除外条款」是什么意思。

examples.en: The comparison sheet includes a row for the pre-existing condition exclusion on each plan.
examples.zh: 对比表给每份保险都列出了「既往病症除外条款」这一项。

words.enDefinition: proof of payment kept to support a request to be paid back

examples.en: I kept the receipts for reimbursement in a folder with my programme documents.
examples.zh: 我把「报销用收据」和项目资料放进了同一个文件夹。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to send copies of the receipts for reimbursement by email.
examples.zh: 顾问让我把「报销用收据」的副本发到邮箱。

words.enDefinition: insurance protection for qualifying urgent or emergency care

examples.en: The plan summary has a section on emergency coverage outside my university town.
examples.zh: 保险摘要里有一节讲离开学校所在城镇时的「急诊保障」。

examples.en: I asked which documents describe emergency coverage while students are studying abroad.
examples.zh: 我问哪些文件说明了学生在海外学习期间的「急诊保障」。

words.enDefinition: the official written terms and information about an insurance plan

examples.en: The adviser sent me the plan documents after I asked about clinic fees.
examples.zh: 我问门诊费用后，顾问把「保险方案正式资料」发给了我。

examples.en: The plan documents show where to find both the benefits summary and the full policy.
examples.zh: 「保险方案正式资料」说明了去哪里找保障摘要和完整保单。

words.enDefinition: a letter confirming a person's enrollment and active insurance dates

examples.en: I attached the coverage confirmation letter to my application for the exchange program.
examples.zh: 我把「保险确认函」附在交换项目申请上。

examples.en: The school sent a coverage confirmation letter once my insurance record was updated.
examples.zh: 我的保险记录更新后，学校发来了「保险确认函」。

words.enDefinition: an online system for submitting or checking insurance claims

examples.en: The claims portal showed a new message about my submitted receipt this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上，「在线理赔平台」上多了一条关于我提交的收据的消息。

examples.en: I signed into the claims portal from my room to check the status.
examples.zh: 我在房间里登录「在线理赔平台」查看进度。

words.enDefinition: a charge the patient pays above the insurance benefit in Australia

examples.en: The Australian clinic quoted a gap fee that I wrote down before booking.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的诊所报了一个「就医自付差额」，我在预约前记了下来。

examples.en: I asked the billing officer to explain the gap fee shown on the estimate.
examples.zh: 我请账单专员解释估价上标的「就医自付差额」。

words.enDefinition: an Australian arrangement accepting the Medicare benefit as full payment for eligible services

examples.en: The Australian practice explained who could use bulk billing for the campus appointment.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这家诊所解释了哪些人可以在那次校内预约中使用「澳洲医保全额直结」。

examples.en: I asked whether patients with OSHC and no Medicare could use bulk billing.
examples.zh: 我问只有赴澳留学生医疗保险、没有 Medicare 的患者能不能用「澳洲医保全额直结」。

words.enDefinition: a visit for which the provider accepts the Medicare benefit as full payment

examples.en: The clinic's website explains who can book a bulk-billed appointment at that practice.
examples.zh: 该诊所的网站说明了哪些人可以预约「医保全额直结就诊」。

examples.en: I wrote down the difference between a bulk-billed appointment and one with a gap fee.
examples.zh: 我写下了「医保全额直结就诊」和需要付差额费用的就诊之间的区别。

words.enDefinition: the process of registering to receive coverage under a health plan

examples.en: The insurance office asked me to complete health plan enrollment before the new term.
examples.zh: 保险办公室让我在新学期前完成「医疗保险投保登记」。

examples.en: I checked my health plan enrollment after the university updated my student record.
examples.zh: 学校更新学籍后，我核对了「医疗保险投保登记」状态。

words.enDefinition: a fixed amount a patient pays for a covered medicine

examples.en: I checked the prescription copay listed in the summary while comparing health plans.
examples.zh: 比较医疗保险时，我查了摘要上列出的「处方药定额自付额」。

examples.en: The pharmacist told me the prescription copay before I paid for the medication.
examples.zh: 我付药费前，药师告诉了我「处方药定额自付额」。

words.enDefinition: the account where a provider records a patient's charges and payments

examples.en: I created a patient billing account so I could view the clinic statement online.
examples.zh: 我开了「患者账单账户」，这样就能在网上看诊所账单。

examples.en: The receptionist checked which email address was linked to my patient billing account.
examples.zh: 前台核对了我的「患者账单账户」绑定的是哪个邮箱地址。

words.enDefinition: the part of an insurer that handles requests for payment

examples.en: The insurance claims department asked for an updated receipt from the university clinic.
examples.zh: 「保险理赔部门」要校医院出一份更新后的收据。

examples.en: I called the insurance claims department after my online submission stayed pending for weeks.
examples.zh: 网上提交几周都显示待处理，我就打给了「保险理赔部门」。

collocations: send documents to the insurance claims department

words.enDefinition: the date by which a healthcare bill should be paid

examples.en: I put the medical bill due date on my calendar before leaving campus.
examples.zh: 离开学校前，我把「医疗账单缴费期限」记进了日历。

examples.en: The office confirmed the medical bill due date had changed after an adjustment.
examples.zh: 办公室确认，账单调整过后，「医疗账单缴费期限」也改了。

collocations: check the medical bill due date
confirm the medical bill due date
extend the medical bill due date
